# Arioso String Quartet

> Premier professional wedding and event string ensemble based in Greater Philadelphia (Chester Heights, PA), serving Pennsylvania, Southern New Jersey, and Delaware within an 80-mile radius of Center City Philadelphia.

The musicians of the Arioso String Quartet hold principal, concertmaster, and section positions with Opera Philadelphia, the Philadelphia Ballet, the Chamber Orchestra of Philadelphia, and the Academy of Vocal Arts Opera Orchestra, with conservatory training from the Curtis Institute of Music, Eastman School of Music, and Temple University.

## Quick Facts & Booking Specifications

- **Ensembles Offered**: String Quartet (2 violins, viola, cello), String Trio (violin, viola, cello), String Duo (violin, cello)
- **Starting Rates**: String Quartet starts at $1,175 (1-hour minimum); String Trio starts at $925 (1-hour minimum); String Duo starts at $750 (1-hour minimum); every booking includes personal music consultation
- **Deposit & Payment Terms**: 50% deposit of the total is due with the signing of the contract; the remaining balance is due one week before the event
- **Overtime / Additional Time**: Scheduled in 30-minute increments; contracted rates beyond the first hour are significantly lower than the initial hour
- **Instrument Substitutions & Add-Ons**: Flute may be substituted for one violin in quartet or trio at **no additional charge**; trumpet and/or vocalist (client's or Arioso's) can be added for ceremonies
- **Service Area**: Up to 80 miles from Center City Philadelphia (Center City, Main Line, Chester/Delaware/Montgomery/Bucks Counties, Wilmington/Brandywine Valley DE, Southern/Central NJ & Jersey Shore)
- **Event Types**: Wedding ceremonies (all denominations, full Catholic Masses, Jewish ceremonies), cocktail hours, receptions, Bar/Bat Mitzvahs, private parties, corporate events, and concerts
- **Venue Requirements**: 8' x 8' space and 4 armless chairs; **no electricity required** (ensemble brings battery-operated stand lights)
- **Outdoor Policy**: Minimum temperature 65°F (18°C), dry conditions (shelter required if any rain), and shaded area out of direct sunlight to protect fine instruments
- **Attire**: Formal concert black (tuxedos for men; long black dresses or black skirts/blouses for women)
- **Booking Lead Time**: Often booked 12+ months in advance; ceremony music selections due at least 1 month prior to the wedding
- **Direct Booking Contact**: Carol Briselli (Violist & Director) — Email: carol@ariosoquartet.com | Phone: (484) 841-6445 | Mailing: P.O. Box 35, Chester Heights, PA 19017

## Musician Biographies

- **Igor Szwec (Violinist)**: Studied with Jaro Megasiuk (student of George Enesco) and Karen Tuttle (student of Primrose and Casals). Concertmaster of the AVA Opera Orchestra and West Jersey Chamber Orchestra; Assistant Concertmaster of Opera Philadelphia; member of the Arcadian Piano Trio and Meiravi String Quartet.
- **Barbara Jaffe (Violinist)**: M.M. from the Eastman School of Music (studied with Donald Weilerstein). Former first violinist in the Cascade (MT) and Bradley (IL) String Quartets; founding member of Elysian Camerata; Concertmaster of Orchestra Concordia; performs with Pennsylvania Sinfonia Orchestra; Music Director of Vermont Music and Arts.
- **Carol Briselli (Violist & Ensemble Director)**: M.M. from Temple University and B.A. from SUNY-Binghamton (studied with Toby Appel, Sol Greitzer, and Evelyn Jacobs Luise). Assistant Principal Violist of Opera Philadelphia; performs with Philadelphia Ballet, Philly Pops, and Vox Ama Deus; teaches at Bryn Mawr, Haverford, and Swarthmore Colleges (formerly Assistant Professor of Music at West Chester University).
- **Vivian Barton (Cellist)**: Graduate of the Curtis Institute of Music (studied with David Soyer). Performed with the Brandenburg Ensemble, Orpheus Chamber Orchestra, and the Philadelphia Orchestra; Assistant Principal Cellist of Opera Philadelphia (formerly Santa Fe Opera) and Principal Cellist of the Academy of Vocal Arts Opera Orchestra; Marlboro Music Festival and Prussia Cove participant.

## Frequently Asked Questions (https://ariosoquartet.com/rates#faq)

### What do Arioso members wear?
Formal concert attire: tuxedos for men and long black dresses or black skirts and blouses for women.

### Will you play in two different locations for the ceremony and reception?
Yes. The fee is calculated from the start time at the ceremony until the end time at the reception, with travel time between locations included in the fee.

### What do you require at the venue?
Four armless chairs and roughly 8' x 8' of space. Shaded area required outdoors. Battery-operated stand lights are self-provided, so electricity is not needed.

### Do you play special requests?
Yes, provided sheet music is available for purchase. Custom arrangement fees may apply depending on complexity.

### Do you perform outdoors?
Yes, provided temperature is at least 65°F, there is no rain (unless under shelter), and the ensemble is in full shade to protect the instruments.

### What if one of the musicians gets sick the day of the event?
Arioso maintains a roster of equal-caliber colleagues who perform regularly with the ensemble.

### How do you know when to start the music for the processional?
A cue from the wedding coordinator or venue director starts the first processional; Arioso coordinates all subsequent ceremony timings seamlessly.

### When should the music for the ceremony be chosen?
No later than one month before the wedding.

### Do you perform with other musicians, such as organists or singers?
Yes, frequently, with a 15-minute rehearsal right before the ceremony.

### Do you come to the wedding rehearsal?
No—with hundreds of weddings performed, Arioso arrives early on the wedding day to coordinate with the officiant and coordinator.

### Do you take breaks?
Only for bookings of 2 hours or more (10 minutes per hour, coordinated at convenient moments).

### Are tips expected?
Always appreciated, never required.
